text:
The Company shall indemnify the medical expenses incurred for in-patient care where the insured person is hospitalised for a minimum period of 24 consecutive hours on the advice of a medical practitioner.
Covered expenses include room rent, boarding and nursing expenses, intensive care unit charges, fees of surgeons, anaesthetists and consultants, cost of medicines, drugs, diagnostic tests, operation theatre charges and cost of implants.
text_for_embedding:
[Policy: Demo Health Shield | Section B - Coverage > B.1 In-patient Hospitalisation]
The Company shall indemnify the medical expenses incurred for in-patient care where the insured person is hospitalised for a minimum period of 24 consecutive hours on the advice of a medical practitioner.
Covered expenses include room rent, boarding and nursing expenses, intensive care unit charges, fees of surgeons, anaesthetists and consultants, cost of medicines, drugs, diagnostic tests, operation theatre charges and cost of implants.

text:
Room rent, boarding and nursing expenses are payable up to 1% of the Sum Insured per day. Intensive Care Unit charges are payable up to 2% of the Sum Insured per day.
If the insured person occupies a room with a rent higher than the eligible limit, all associated medical expenses, except cost of medicines, implants and consumables, shall be payable in the same proportion as the eligible room rent bears to the actual room rent.

text: Medical expenses incurred up to 30 days before the date of admission and up to 60 days after the date of discharge are covered, provided the in-patient claim is admissible under the policy.

clause: Code-Excl02 Specified Disease or Procedure Waiting Period
text:
Expenses related to the treatment of the listed conditions, surgeries or treatments shall be excluded until the expiry of 24 months of continuous coverage after the date of inception of the first policy with the insurer.
The listed conditions include: cataract; benign prostatic hypertrophy; hernia of all types; joint replacement including knee and hip replacement unless necessitated by accident; surgery for varicose veins; gall bladder stones; kidney stones; sinusitis; tonsillectomy; and hysterectomy.
